beats.summary: Pam and Jim comment on their parking situation and see a strange sight.

evidence.snippet: Pam: W.B. Jones is renovating their offices and their construction crews are taking up some of the parking spaces we used to get.
Jim: So we had to park at a satellite parking lot over there.

beats.summary: Oscar expresses frustration about parking and Kevin threatens to quit if the parking issue isn't fixed.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Been here nine years. Now all of a sudden I'm supposed to park half a mile away.
Kevin (sitting down, rubbing his feet): I will quit. As God as my witness, I will quit if this is not fixed.
